bullets: On Monday 16 November, Dubai DLD recorded 820 sales worth AED 2.4bn, which is 12.8% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan share reached 65.2% on Monday, compared to the 7-day average of 55.4%.
The median price was AED 1,829 per sqft, up 9.1% over 30 days but down 1.7% year-on-year.
Weekly sales averaged 502 per day, down 45.1% from 914 per day in the same week last year.
In October new contracts, JVC 1-bedroom apartments had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, rising 1.2% on the month.
